shortDescription: Manage bits and pieces of XML files or strings

options.name: add_children
options.description: Add additional child-element(s) to a selected element for a given I(xpath). Child elements must be given in a list and each item may be either a string (eg. C(children=ansible) to add an empty C(<ansible/>) child element), or a hash where the key is an element name and the value is the element value. This parameter requires I(xpath) to be set.

options.name: attribute
options.description: The attribute to select when using parameter I(value). This is a string, not prepended with C(@).

options.name: backup
options.description: Create a backup file including the timestamp information so you can get the original file back if you somehow clobbered it incorrectly.

options.name: content
options.description: Search for a given I(xpath) and get content. This parameter requires I(xpath) to be set.

options.name: count
options.description: Search for a given I(xpath) and provide the count of any matches. This parameter requires I(xpath) to be set.

options.name: input_type
options.description: Type of input for I(add_children) and I(set_children).

options.name: insertafter
options.description: Add additional child-element(s) after the last selected element for a given I(xpath). Child elements must be given in a list and each item may be either a string (eg. C(children=ansible) to add an empty C(<ansible/>) child element), or a hash where the key is an element name and the value is the element value. This parameter requires I(xpath) to be set.

options.name: insertbefore
options.description: Add additional child-element(s) before the first selected element for a given I(xpath). Child elements must be given in a list and each item may be either a string (eg. C(children=ansible) to add an empty C(<ansible/>) child element), or a hash where the key is an element name and the value is the element value. This parameter requires I(xpath) to be set.

options.name: namespaces
options.description: The namespace C(prefix:uri) mapping for the XPath expression. Needs to be a C(dict), not a C(list) of items.

options.name: path
options.description: Path to the file to operate on. This file must exist ahead of time. This parameter is required, unless I(xmlstring) is given.

options.name: pretty_print
options.description: Pretty print XML output.

options.name: print_match
options.description: Search for a given I(xpath) and print out any matches. This parameter requires I(xpath) to be set.

options.name: set_children
options.description: Set the child-element(s) of a selected element for a given I(xpath). Removes any existing children. Child elements must be specified as in I(add_children). This parameter requires I(xpath) to be set.

options.name: state
options.description: Set or remove an xpath selection (node(s), attribute(s)).

options.name: strip_cdata_tags
options.description: Remove CDATA tags surrounding text values. Note that this might break your XML file if text values contain characters that could be interpreted as XML.

options.name: validate
options.description: Perform schema validation of the XML input. This parameter requires I(xsd_path) to be set.

options.name: value
options.description: Desired state of the selected attribute. Either a string, or to unset a value, the Python C(None) keyword (YAML Equivalent, C(null)). Elements default to no value (but present). Attributes default to an empty string.

options.name: xmlstring
options.description: A string containing XML on which to operate. This parameter is required, unless I(path) is given.

options.name: xpath
options.description: A valid XPath expression describing the item(s) you want to manipulate. Operates on the document root, C(/), by default.

options.name: xsd_path
options.description: Path to the xsd schema file to perform xml validation This file must exist ahead of time. This parameter is required when I(validate) is true.
